bead.title: Repair sqlite historical-read conformance
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The sqlite relational backend must satisfy the historical projection contract that the release matrix exercises.
ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-sqlite/src/relational.rs:7868-7895` is the `HistoricalProjectionRead` seam for `SqliteRelationalBackend`; the release failure was the missing or mismatched implementation at that boundary.
PROPOSED FIX: wire the historical read-as-of path on `SqliteRelationalBackend`, keep the documented fail-closed behavior if that remains the contract, and add a focused test that proves the trait boundary is wired correctly.
NON-SCOPE: postgres wrapper construction, CI/release workflow changes, and server-side test/helper cleanup.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestSqliteRelationalHistoricalProjectionRead: `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite relational_conformance -- --nocapture` covers the historical-read trait seam.
2. TestHistoricalProjectionReadContractIsExplicit: a focused relational test proves the read-as-of behavior is either implemented or explicitly fail-closed under the documented contract.
3. TestGoTestGate: `go test ./...` passes.
4. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
